snippet.title: Mingle is here! 👀👥
snippet.description:
Mingle, a classic hidden object game with an active twist, is now available with Play Pass! Seek, find, and merge your way through 25 unique maps, unlocking loads of cute characters, trophies, and wallpapers as you play.

The quicker you clear the levels, the better your score, so grab a friend and start mingling and merging.

Mingle is Nex’s second collaboration with Cookie Crayon, the studio behind Aeon Guard. Give it a try and let us know what you think. Can anyone earn 3 stars on a Mingle level today? Share below!

Don’t miss out—subscribe for updates and exclusive gameplay previews.
📲 Get Connected: https://www.facebook.com/groups/nexplayground/ 
💡 Learn more about Nex Playground: https://www.nexplayground.com/
